title: Add the user-management module
description: Copy the user-management module — ManagedUser model, mock-backed UserService (UserStorage-backed), the users list (avatar thumbnail, status badge, row actions), add/edit forms (shared UserForm), and the details/change-role/deactivate dialogs — into an existing project, and wire its routes as ordinary children of whatever main shell already exists (or as flat top-level routes if there is none). Zero dependency on modules:auth or modules:rbac in either direction — a deliberately simpler sync than either: no cross-module coupling to manage, no special layout needed, reuses generator-kit's appendChildRoutes built for RBAC unchanged.

list.description: Print a one-line self-description and exit without writing anything.

routePrefix.description: Where the users list mounts, e.g. '<routePrefix>' (the list itself), '<routePrefix>/new', '<routePrefix>/:id/edit'. The one configurable option — this module has no runtime-strategy branch to parameterize the way auth does.
